## Family coverage cannot be inferred from output count

The source's productive interval is[0,14336),16*896 arbitrary data families;
its physical capacity is14826 including work. RESULT binds the exact active
X/Y family intervals and next bridge readset at every proposed cut. No source
instruction allocates or reads the new output bank as a productive family.

A concrete control varies the arbitrary initial dirt in an owned W output slot.
Its first operation is CLEAR, so both dirty states yield the same result.
Therefore appending this slot does not preserve that slot as an arbitrary
productive input under the selected family contract. It cannot merely be
counted as an additional independent source data family in the existing proof.
This does not exclude a different zero-input/encoded supplier theorem; its
coverage and denominator would need to be derived separately.

Similarly, the actual incidence ledger does not prove that14336 productive
families, centre64, or the selected idle completion survive substitution of
QQ16 locals and a module. PR3339 already warns that unchanged idle additivity
is not an unconditional inference. This package assigns no displaced-idle
credit and does not strengthen that earlier result into an obstruction.

## Source-rate conditional moment and sharp integer cap

Assume, only for this screen, m=73,W_global=14336,N=144, fixed mass
T=72W_global+64N, and the inherited halving guard. Every idle rank is at most51.
For a≥0 the cost per rank-mass unit decreases with rank, so replacing all
remaining mass by fractional rank51 idle work is favorable. With the exact
nine-word producer histogram H and sixteen d-H1 modules, use

    H_d=H+16d*{rank1},
    G(d)=[sum_r H_d(r)(r/73)^(1-a)
          +(T-sum_r r H_d(r))/51*(51/73)^(1-a)]/14336.

All maps, wrappers, scalar, movement, precision, storage and placement costs
are favorably zero in this numerical screen. Their local invoices are not
zero-cost implementations. At the selected target
`a=836330098538459/499163669901461541`, exact outward bounds are:

The208/224/304 rows are parameter values only, not admissions of contemporaneous

The strict integer cap in this fixed model is553 because replacing idle rank

## Decision and next test

Do not reject a once-per-stage1 module using the older one-per-two-call screen.
The exact cut rate and full nine-word mean leave a favorable conditional margin,
including for336 native children. The next decision is the first real provider
and read binding:choose a complete continuation which consumes the projected
or reconstructed values at one enumerated site, then map its owned/borrowed
lifetimes and native children to displaced old work. Recompute coverage and
